text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
A fierce, overwhelming, supreme 
performance. Showing off her immense 
strength to the fullest, Duramente 
captured the second crown of the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Her run was so magnificent that even the 
Umamusume who ran alongside her 
acknowledged it.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
When she returned to the waiting room, the 
members of the family welcomed her back 
with a big round of applause.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Before the gathered crowd, Duramente 
declared: Her next step was the world—to 
take on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
